about: racehorse_v2: how to play the clips. Every clip is one stride (0.48 s) unless noted; play them together and in step. Scale playback by speed / 14.6 m/s (model scaled x3).

detailLevels.racehorse_v2_close: within about 25 m of the camera (or the horse fills a quarter of the screen)

horse.gallop_v2: normal galloping (rebalanced 13 Nov: forehand up as the hind legs push, hooves planted at 14.6 m/s)
horse.gallop_v2_drive: under pressure: neck lower, deeper nod, tail higher, a little flatter; blend in a beat after the jockey asks
horse.walk: walking / standing in the stalls (from v1)

jockey.ride_quiet: effort 0: sitting still, hands on the neck
jockey.ride_push: effort 1: hands and heels, arms pushing with the stride, back pumping
jockey.ride_drive: effort 2: the same, bigger and lower
jockey.ride_whip: effort 3, TWO strides (0.96 s): a stroke with the stick in his right hand in the first stride, both hands pushing through the second

effort: timeline effort 0..3. Weights: quiet = max(0, 1 - e); push = max(0, 1 - |e - 1|); drive = max(0, 1 - |e - 2|); whip = max(0, e - 2). The horse: gallop_v2_drive = min(1, e / 2) of a copy of e delayed about 0.4 s.

variety.additive: ramp clips: rest at the start, the pose at the end. Play additively, held at the end, weight 0..1, chosen once per runner from its seed.
variety.stride: cadence x0.95..1.05 per horse; the jockey's clips run 0..0.04 s off the horse's stride per jockey

moments.additive: ramp clips like the variety poses, but faded in and out by the viewer rather than held
moments.jky_look_left: a look round over his left shoulder (about 1.5 s: round, hold, back), now and then while he sits quietly
moments.jky_stand: standing in his irons to pull up, once past the post

colours: main material: vertex colour R = coat, G = points (mane, tail, lower legs), B = jockey's skin. Multiply the grey texture's light and shade by the chosen colour inside each. Silks material: the owner's v2 silks texture times the vertex colour (fabric creases).
